clips.title: I'll Go to the Audition Instead
grammar: 〜おうか — shall I / offering to do something
代わりに — instead of / in place of

lines.ja: お願いしますよ、大事なオーディションなんですから。
lines.en: Come on, please, it's an important audition.
lines.speaker: Young Man

lines.ja: そのオーディション、代わりに行こうか。
lines.en: Shall I go to that audition instead?
lines.speaker: Gen

lines.ja: いないでしょ、芝居ができて誰も知らない俳優なんて。
lines.en: There's no such thing as an actor who can act and nobody knows.
lines.speaker: Man

lines.en: Ninety-nine percent of Japanese people have forgotten him.
lines.speaker: Gen
